rules.content:
/*
ValenciaLeaks ransomware
*/

rule ValenciaLeaks_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.valencialeaks"
        description = "Detects ValenciaLeaks ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "ValenciaLeaks" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "VALENCIALEAKS" ascii
        $onion  = "valencialeaks.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
